## PURPOSE

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# PURPOSE
# ============================================================================
# Model Comparison Workflow:
#   1. Define global parameters and feature sets.
#   2. Train multiple models (GBM, XGBoost) on the SIPP donor sample.
#   3. Aggregate hyperparameter settings into a single reference table.
#   4. Score the target-like SIPP test sample for all models.
#   5. Evaluate PR AUC and automatically export ONLY the highest-performing model.
# ============================================================================

report_timestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z")
cat("Report rendered at:", report_timestamp, "\n")

# Packages
library(here) 
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(gbm)
library(xgboost)
library(caret)
library(pROC)
library(ROCR) # Required for PR AUC
library(knitr)
library(tidyr)
```

## 1. SETUP & PATHS

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 1. SETUP & PATHS
# ============================================================================
report_timestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z")
cat("Report rendered at:", report_timestamp, "\n")

library(here) 
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(caret)
library(ROCR)
library(MLmetrics)
library(knitr)

# Model Libraries
library(catboost)
library(xgboost)
library(lightgbm)
library(ranger)
library(ada)

# Paths
if (Sys.info()["sysname"] == "Windows") {
  base_dir <- "G:/Shared drives/Undocu Research"
} else {
  base_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-vsovero@ucr.edu/Shared drives/Undocu Research"
}

data_path <- file.path(base_dir, "Data")
ml_output_path <- here("ML Outputs")
dir.create(ml_output_path, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

acs_prediction_export <- file.path(ml_output_path, "ACS_SIPP_8Model_Predictions.csv")
```

## 2. READ AND CLEAN BASE DATA

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 2. READ AND CLEAN BASE DATA
# ============================================================================
sipp_file <- file.path(data_path, "(Step 1 output) Core_TM SIPP 2008 Wave 2.csv")
acs_file  <- file.path(data_path, "ACS Target Sample.csv")

sipp_raw <- read_csv(sipp_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
acs_raw <- read_csv(acs_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

features <- c("age", "fem", "married", "cit_spouse", "medicaid", "nonfluent", 
              "spanish_hispanic_latino", "central_latino", "bpl_asia", 
              "household_size", "poverty", "asian", "black", "white", 
              "other_race", "years_us", "years_us_missing", "yrsed")

sipp <- sipp_raw %>%
  mutate(undocu_likely = ifelse(undocu_likely %in% c("X1", "1", 1), 1, 0)) %>%
  filter(age >= 18, age <= 55, employed == 1) %>%
  drop_na(all_of(features), undocu_likely, college)

acs <- acs_raw %>% drop_na(all_of(features))

# Split SIPP
set.seed(1)
train_index <- createDataPartition(sipp$undocu_likely, p = 0.70, list = FALSE)
sipp_train <- sipp[train_index, ]
sipp_test <- sipp[-train_index, ]

# Define Target-Like Validation Set
sipp_targetlike <- sipp_test %>%
  filter(college == 1, employed == 1, age >= 22, age <= 55)
```

## 3. FORMAT DATA STRUCTURES FOR DIVERSE MODELS

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 3. FORMAT DATA STRUCTURES FOR DIVERSE MODELS
# ============================================================================
# Extract features and targets
x_train <- sipp_train %>% select(all_of(features))
y_train_num <- as.numeric(sipp_train$undocu_likely)

x_valid <- sipp_targetlike %>% select(all_of(features))
y_valid_num <- as.numeric(sipp_targetlike$undocu_likely)

x_acs <- acs %>% select(all_of(features))

# A. CatBoost Pools
pool_train <- catboost.load_pool(data = x_train, label = y_train_num)
pool_valid <- catboost.load_pool(data = x_valid, label = y_valid_num)
pool_acs   <- catboost.load_pool(data = x_acs)

# B. Caret Dataframes (Require Factor Targets)
caret_train <- x_train %>% mutate(undocu_likely = factor(y_train_num, levels = c(1, 0), labels = c("Class1", "Class0")))
caret_valid <- x_valid %>% mutate(undocu_likely = factor(y_valid_num, levels = c(1, 0), labels = c("Class1", "Class0")))
caret_acs   <- x_acs

# C. One-Hot Matrices (XGBoost & LightGBM)
dummy_model <- dummyVars(~ ., data = x_train)
mat_train <- predict(dummy_model, newdata = x_train)
mat_valid <- predict(dummy_model, newdata = x_valid)
mat_acs   <- predict(dummy_model, newdata = x_acs)

# XGBoost DMatrices
dtrain_xgb <- xgb.DMatrix(data = mat_train, label = y_train_num)
dvalid_xgb <- xgb.DMatrix(data = mat_valid, label = y_valid_num)
dacs_xgb   <- xgb.DMatrix(data = mat_acs)

# LightGBM Datasets
lgb_train <- lgb.Dataset(data = mat_train, label = y_train_num)
```

## 4. TRAIN THE 8 MODELS

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 4. TRAIN THE 8 MODELS
# ============================================================================
# Note: When rendering this Quarto document, this chunk will take time to 
# execute due to the comprehensive caret cross-validation grids.
# ============================================================================
models <- list()
caret_ctrl <- trainControl(method="cv", number=5, summaryFunction=prSummary, classProbs=TRUE)

# 1. CatBoost
set.seed(1)
models$CatBoost <- catboost.train(
  learn_pool = pool_train, 
  params = list(loss_function='Logloss', eval_metric='PRAUC', iterations=500, logging_level='Silent')
)

# 2. XGBoost
set.seed(1)
models$XGBoost <- xgb.train(
  params = list(objective="binary:logistic", eval_metric="aucpr", eta=0.05, max_depth=6), 
  data = dtrain_xgb, nrounds = 500, verbose = 0
)

# 3. LightGBM
set.seed(1)
models$LightGBM <- lgb.train(
  params = list(objective="binary", metric="average_precision", learning_rate=0.05, num_leaves=31), 
  data = lgb_train, nrounds = 500, verbose = -1
)

# 4. Random Forest (ranger)
set.seed(1)
models$`Random Forest` <- ranger(
  dependent.variable.name="undocu_likely", data=caret_train, 
  num.trees=500, probability=TRUE
)

# 5. Caret Models (GBM, GLM, KNN, AdaBoost)
set.seed(1)
models$GBM <- train(undocu_likely ~ ., data=caret_train, method="gbm", metric="AUC", trControl=caret_ctrl, verbose=FALSE)

models$`Logistic Regression` <- train(undocu_likely ~ ., data=caret_train, method="glmnet", metric="AUC", trControl=caret_ctrl)

models$KNN <- train(undocu_likely ~ ., data=caret_train, method="knn", metric="AUC", trControl=caret_ctrl, preProcess=c("center", "scale"))

models$AdaBoost <- train(undocu_likely ~ ., data=caret_train, method="ada", metric="AUC", trControl=caret_ctrl)

cat("Successfully trained all 8 models.\n")
```

## 5. VALIDATE TARGET-LIKE SAMPLE & GENERATE THRESHOLDS

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 5. VALIDATE TARGET-LIKE SAMPLE & GENERATE THRESHOLDS
# ============================================================================
# Helper to generate predictions based on algorithm type
generate_preds <- function(algo, model_obj, cat_pool, xgb_mat, lgb_mat, caret_df) {
  if (algo == "CatBoost") return(catboost.predict(model_obj, cat_pool, prediction_type = "Probability"))
  if (algo == "XGBoost")  return(predict(model_obj, newdata = xgb_mat))
  if (algo == "LightGBM") return(predict(model_obj, newdata = lgb_mat))
  if (algo == "Random Forest") return(predict(model_obj, data = caret_df)$predictions[, "Class1"])
  return(predict(model_obj, newdata = caret_df, type = "prob")[, "Class1"])
}

# Helper for PR AUC Calculation
calc_auc_pr <- function(preds, true_y) {
  perf_obj <- performance(prediction(preds, true_y), "prec", "rec")
  x <- perf_obj@x.values[[1]]; y <- perf_obj@y.values[[1]]
  idx <- order(x); x <- x[idx]; y <- y[idx]
  sum(diff(x) * (y[-1] + y[-length(y)]) / 2, na.rm = TRUE)
}

val_results <- data.frame(Algorithm = character(), PR_AUC = numeric(), Threshold_75 = numeric())
thresholds <- list()

for (algo in names(models)) {
  # Predict on Target-Like validation set
  preds <- generate_preds(algo, models[[algo]], pool_valid, dvalid_xgb, mat_valid, caret_valid)
  
  # Calculate Metrics
  pr_auc_score <- calc_auc_pr(preds, y_valid_num)
  
  # Calculate top 75% high-recall threshold
  valid_df <- tibble(p = preds, y = y_valid_num)
  t_75 <- min((valid_df %>% filter(y == 1) %>% arrange(desc(p)) %>% slice(1:floor(0.75 * n())))$p)
  
  # Store results
  val_results <- rbind(val_results, data.frame(Algorithm = algo, PR_AUC = pr_auc_score, Threshold_75 = t_75))
  thresholds[[algo]] <- t_75
}

val_results <- val_results %>% arrange(desc(PR_AUC))
kable(val_results, digits = 4, caption = "Target-Like SIPP Validation Metrics")
```

## 6. SCORE ACS TARGET SAMPLE AND EXPORT DATA

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 6. SCORE ACS TARGET SAMPLE AND EXPORT DATA
# ============================================================================
acs_export <- acs %>% select(year, serial, pernum)

for (algo in names(models)) {
  # Generate continuous probabilities for ACS
  acs_probs <- generate_preds(algo, models[[algo]], pool_acs, dacs_xgb, mat_acs, caret_acs)
  
  # Assign to column based on algorithm name (e.g., CatBoost_p)
  col_p <- paste0(make.names(algo), "_p")
  col_hr <- paste0(make.names(algo), "_high_recall")
  
  acs_export[[col_p]] <- acs_probs
  acs_export[[col_hr]] <- ifelse(acs_probs >= thresholds[[algo]], 1, 0)
}

write_csv(acs_export, acs_prediction_export)
cat("Exported predictions for all 8 algorithms to:", acs_prediction_export, "\n")
```

## 7. AUTOMATED BEST MODEL SELECTION & SAVE

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 7. AUTOMATED BEST MODEL SELECTION & SAVE
# ============================================================================
# Change to a specific algorithm name (e.g., "XGBoost") to manually override 
manual_override <- "Auto"

if (manual_override %in% names(models)) {
  best_model_name <- manual_override
  cat("Manual Override Engaged. Saving Model:", best_model_name, "\n")
} else {
  best_model_name <- val_results$Algorithm[which.max(val_results$PR_AUC)]
  cat("Automatic Selection Engaged. Best Model (by PR AUC):", best_model_name, "\n")
}

# Define dynamic paths for the singular winning model
best_model_file <- file.path(ml_output_path, "best_ml_model.rds")
best_metadata_file <- file.path(ml_output_path, "best_ml_metadata.rds")

final_model <- models[[best_model_name]]
final_metadata <- list(
  algorithm = best_model_name,
  report_timestamp = report_timestamp,
  features = features,
  pr_auc = val_results$PR_AUC[val_results$Algorithm == best_model_name],
  threshold_75 = thresholds[[best_model_name]]
)

# Save only the best model and its metadata
saveRDS(final_model, best_model_file)
saveRDS(final_metadata, best_metadata_file)

tibble(
  saved_object = c(paste("Winner:", best_model_name), "Matching Metadata"),
  path = c(best_model_file, best_metadata_file)
) %>%
  kable()
```
